text:
emily: Quick poll  Prague offsite next month. Hand-carry only or check a bag?
ravi: hand-carry 95% of the time. no waiting at baggage claim = win.
toni: checked if you want a blazer or extra shoes. depends on dinners.
carlos: bring a slim roller + backpack. cobblestones = wear comfy shoes.
emily: early AM flight from LON, any early-flight survival tips?
ravi: check-in 24h, wear the bulkiest stuff, hydration, coffee after security.
toni: naps on trains to the airport if possible. two alarms.
emily: packing list (carry-on):
```
- 1 blazer (wear on plane)
- 2 shirts
- 1 pair dress shoes (wear the bulkiest)
- packing cube with socks/underwear
- mini toiletries (100ml)
- travel adaptor + charger
```
carlos: bring gel insoles for walking. umbrella or light rain jacket for sudden showers.
travel-bot: Reminder: book via company portal for policy compliance. save receipts for reimbursement.
emily: leaning carry-on + packing cube + umbrella. thanks everyone! :pray:
